connector.name: Bounty Api
connector.registryDescription: Singapore property & financial data APIs for AI agents. 27 MCP tools. x402 micropayments.
connector.summary: Hosted at bountyapi.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package bountyapi-mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the vncent786 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: EVM_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: Optional. EVM private key to enable auto-pay for paid endpoints via x402. Without it, only the 8 free endpoints are callable; paid endpoints return a 402 payment challenge. Never required to use the free tier.
